newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iranian president Rafsanjani to visit Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Iranian president Rafsanjani to visit Turkey.

text.p: Iranian President Ali Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani is likely to visit neighbouring Turkey this month, foreign ministry spokesman Omer Akbel said on Wednesday.

"The Iranian president's visit is on the agenda, I guess before next year," Akbel told a news briefing. He did not elaborate but another foreign ministry official said Rafsanjani was due in Turkey in the third week of December.

Turkey's Islamist prime minister, Necmettin Erbakan, visited Iran in August in his first foreign trip since he became premier in June. The two countries signed a $23 billion deal during the visit, which worried Ankara's NATO ally the United States.
The Turkish military accuses Tehran of supporting Kurdish guerrillas active in southeast Turkey. Iran denies this.
